name: cleanurl
description: Removes 900+ tracking parameters from links before they load and from links you copy. Nothing is collected, nothing is sent.

scripts.test: node test/cleaner.test.js && node test/extension.test.js && node test/clipboard.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && npm test && node tools/package.js chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && npm test && node tools/package.js firefox
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build && node tools/package.js firefox --debug
